title: linux: safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Un upgrade cambia il formato di configurazione (breaking). Applica la migrazione mantenendo un percorso di rollback e senza perdere impostazioni. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade'
expected_reasoning: A breaking config-format change needs a migrate-with-rollback plan, not an in-place overwrite.
Back up the old config, run the provided migration (or translate settings) into the new format.
Validate the migrated config, keep the old for rollback, and verify the service on the new format.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: safely apply a breaking config-format migration on upgrade

possible_mistakes: Overwrite the config in the new format with no backup.
Lose custom settings the migration didn't carry.
hints: Keep the old config for rollback.
Diff old vs migrated to catch dropped settings.
reference_solution: Verify service on the new format
alternative_solution: Run old and new versions side by side to compare behavior before cutover.
edge_cases: The migration tool silently drops a deprecated-but-load-bearing option.
goal: Un upgrade cambia il formato di configurazione (breaking). Applica la migrazione mantenendo un percorso di rollback e senza perdere impostazioni.
